snippet.title: Gears of War: E-Day | Official Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
Season 1: Emergence – starts today, featuring Horde Siege, our new 12-player evolution of the iconic Gears wave-based survival mode, set on our largest Horde maps ever made, with shifting objecives, modifiers, secondar missions, and Invasion Events. 

Experience redefined Gears combat in Versus, with new movement mechanics and an updated sandbox that preserve the tension, skill, and teamplay that defines Gears. 

Pre-Order the Premium Edition and play up to 5 days early:
XBOX: https://www.xbox.com/games/store/gears-of-war-e-day-premium-edition-pre-order/9p2qmwj6xsb6 
Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3010850/Gears_of_War_EDay/ 

https://www.gearsofwar.com/
